sn56.38:1.1: yāvakīvañca me bhikkhave, candimasuriyā loke nūppajjanti, neva tāva mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa.
sn56.38:1.3: neva tāva rattindivā paññāyanti, na māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti, na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti.
sn56.38:2.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, candimasūriyā loke uppajjanti, atha mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti, mahato obhāsassa.
sn56.38:2.2: neva andhantamaṃ tadā hoti, na andhakāratimisā.
sn56.38:2.3: atha rattindivā paññāyanti. māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti, utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti.
sn56.38:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, yāvakīvañca tathāgato loke nūppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, neva tāva mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa.
sn56.38:2.6: neva tāva catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ ācikkhanā hoti desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ.
sn56.38:3.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. atha mahato ālokassa pātubhāvo hoti mahato obhāsassa.
sn56.38:3.2: neva andhantamaṃ tadā hoti. na andhakāratimisā.
sn56.38:3.3: atha kho catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ ācikkhanā hoti desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ.
sn56.38:4.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
